content.short: The easiest way to implement flexible and custom governance around a token.
content.description: The Clarity Web Platform is an easy to use website where users can create, manage, and participate in DAOs and web3 organizations on the Cardano blockchain without writing any code. Clarity utilizes a custom chain indexer that reads the Cardano Blockchain, and a suite of traditional web2 technologies to enable the creation, management, and participation in web3 organizations. Clarity also extends the functionality of the Agora Protocol and provides a non-technical user interface that lowers the barrier to entry to create, manage, and participate in.
content.meta: Find out about Clarity ($CLARITY) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
